x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a business application in scope, When its record is opened, Then it relates to at least one application service which relates to its infrastructure CIs Given an incident is logged on a service offering, When the offering is opened, Then the parent business service and owner are shown
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: The service model follows CSDM for business services, offerings, business applications and application services
